title: Coding & Build Copilot Plane
brief: Create activation bundles for 6 coding work classes. Implement auto-routing for build/test/review workflows. Add test-impact analysis to focus test runs on changed code paths.

units.title: Define 6 coding work classes and their capability requirements
Build activation bundles per work class with tool/skill/hook sets
Implement auto-routing: detect work class from prompt and activate bundle
Auto-routing for build workflows: detect build context, activate relevant engines
Auto-routing for test workflows: detect test targets, scope test runs
Test-impact analysis: map changed files to affected tests, focus test runs

exit_conditions: 6 coding work classes defined with activation bundles
Auto-routing activates correct bundle for build/test/review
Test-impact analysis reduces test scope for targeted changes
